title: Daniel J. Riccio Sells 17,375 Shares of Apple (AAPL) Stock
text:
Posted by Sebastian Weber on Apr 22nd, 2018 // No Comments 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Wednesday, April 4th. The shares were sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total transaction of $2,938,460.00. Following the completion of the sale, the senior vice president now owns 66,191 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $11,194,221.92. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is accessible through this hyperlink . 
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $165.72 on Friday. The firm has a market cap of $876,789.50, a PE ratio of 17.99, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.31 and a beta of 1.25. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple has a 52 week low of $141.85 and a 52 week high of $183.50. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. Apple’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the previous year, the business earned $3.36 earnings per share. equities analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.35 earnings per share for the current year.

BlackRock Inc. now owns 319,715,585 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $54,105,468,000 after purchasing an additional 3,048,055 shares in the last quarter. Berkshire Hathaway Inc. now owns 130,191,960 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $18,750,246,000 after purchasing an additional 834,854 shares in the last quarter. Geode Capital Management LLC increased its stake in Apple by 2.5% in the fourth quarter. Geode Capital Management LLC now owns 56,447,158 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,533,267,000 after purchasing an additional 1,356,879 shares in the last quarter. Bank of New York Mellon Corp increased its stake in Apple by 0.7% in the fourth quarter. Bank of New York Mellon Corp now owns 53,301,694 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $9,020,245,000 after purchasing an additional 360,312 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Capital Research Global Investors increased its stake in Apple by 15.0% in the second quarter. Capital Research Global Investors now owns 29,449,961 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,241,383,000 after purchasing an additional 3,845,363 shares in the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 61.35% of the company’s stock. 
Several equities research analysts recently issued reports on AAPL shares. Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Tuesday, December 26th. Wells Fargo reiterated a “hold” rating and issued a $195.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, December 27th. ValuEngine upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research note on Sunday, December 31st. Piper Jaffray reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 2nd. Finally, Zacks Investment Research raised shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $190.00 price target on the stock in a report on Wednesday, January 3rd. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the company. About Apple 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
